assessment.description: Sanitized regression fixture; not evidence of a live agent evaluation.

product.name: Example Checkout
product.overview: A desktop application in which workshop staff select one available tool and one borrowing member, review the pair, and record the checkout. The workspace retains selections after failure and the exact completed pairing after success.
users: Workshop staff recording tool checkouts for borrowing members.

application.summary: One checkout activity area contains one workspace across selection, recording, success, and failure.

shell.description: The application directly hosts the checkout workspace.

navigation.description: The supplied scope requires no navigation between separate work surfaces.

regions.name: Checkout workspace
regions.purpose: Keep the complete checkout task and its result in one place.

areas.name: Checkout
areas.purpose: Record the checkout of an available tool to a borrowing member.

features.name: Tool checkout
features.purpose: Let staff deliberately record a reviewed tool-member pairing and understand the outcome.

useCases.name: Check out a tool
useCases.goal: Record one available tool as checked out to the selected borrowing member.
useCases.trigger: A workshop staff member needs to record a tool checkout.
preconditions: Staff can identify an available tool and its borrowing member in the workspace.
useCases.outcome: The checkout is recorded and its exact tool-member pairing remains visible until staff deliberately begin another checkout.

surfaces.name: Checkout workspace
surfaces.purpose: Select, review, and record one checkout while preserving its context through asynchronous results.
surfaces.entry: Open the application to an empty checkout, or deliberately begin another checkout after success.
surfaces.exit: The task completes in place. Cancel clears an uncommitted attempt; Begin another checkout deliberately replaces the visible completed pair with an empty attempt.
surfaces.focusIntent: Initially focus tool selection. Keep ordinary keyboard operation and visible focus throughout. Preserve focus during ordinary selection changes. Announce asynchronous results without requiring pointer use; make the next available action reachable in task order.

regions.name: Tool and borrowing member
regions.purpose: Identify both selections together for review and retain the relevant pair during saving and after success or failure.

regions.name: Checkout actions
regions.purpose: Record the current pair, cancel an uncommitted attempt, or deliberately begin another checkout after success.

regions.name: Checkout result
regions.purpose: Communicate recording progress, success, or failure in the same workspace.

components.name: Tool selection
components.purpose: Select and visibly identify one available tool.
capabilities: Replace the selection before recording or after failure.
Show the submitted or completed tool without changing its identity.

components.name: Borrowing member selection
components.purpose: Select and visibly identify one borrowing member.
capabilities: Replace the selection before recording or after failure.
Show the submitted or completed member without changing their identity.

components.name: Record checkout
components.purpose: Record the reviewed pair once and govern submission availability.
capabilities: Retry a failed recording through the same command.
Suppress activation while a recording is pending.

components.name: Checkout status
components.purpose: Provide persistent progress and result feedback independently of command availability.
capabilities: Explain that recording is in progress.
Confirm that the checkout was recorded.
Explain that recording failed and identify available recovery.

actions.name: Select tool
actions.purpose: Choose or correct the tool in the current checkout.
actions.outcome: Exactly one selected available tool is visibly associated with the current attempt.

canonicalInteraction.description: Choose a tool using the tool selection control. Replacing the selection updates the current pair without recording it.

alternateInputs.description: Reach the labeled tool selection through ordinary focus navigation and choose using its standard keyboard interaction.

conditions: An empty, editing, or failed checkout attempt is open.

cancellation.description: After making a selection, staff can abandon the uncommitted attempt.

patternBasis.rationale: Choosing one item through an ordinary labeled selection control is a familiar interaction.

actions.name: Select borrowing member
actions.purpose: Choose or correct the member in the current checkout.
actions.outcome: Exactly one borrowing member is visibly associated with the current attempt.

canonicalInteraction.description: Choose a member using the borrowing member selection control. Replacing the selection updates the current pair without recording it.

alternateInputs.description: Reach the labeled member selection through ordinary focus navigation and choose using its standard keyboard interaction.

conditions: An empty, editing, or failed checkout attempt is open.

cancellation.description: After making a selection, staff can abandon the uncommitted attempt.

patternBasis.rationale: Choosing one person through an ordinary labeled selection control is a familiar interaction.

actions.name: Record checkout
actions.purpose: Commit the reviewed pair and provide a clear asynchronous result.
actions.outcome: Success records the selected pair and retains it visibly; failure retains the selections for recovery.

canonicalInteraction.description: After reviewing the visible tool and member, activate Record checkout. The command is unavailable for an incomplete pair and while saving. In failed, its label becomes Retry checkout and it submits the retained pair. Activation enters saving immediately; success enters saved and failure enters failed.

alternateInputs.description: Focus the same command and activate it using its standard keyboard behavior. Repeated activation while saving cannot submit another checkout.

conditions: The workspace is empty, editing, saving, or failed; availability depends on the pair and recording state.

cancellation.description: An in-progress recording cannot be canceled through this workspace. Before submission or after failure, Cancel checkout abandons only the uncommitted attempt.

patternBasis.rationale: An explicit submit command with disabled pending behavior and persistent success or failure feedback is a familiar form interaction; the brief directly supplies the required outcomes.

actions.name: Cancel checkout
actions.outcome: The uncommitted selections are cleared and the workspace returns to empty.

canonicalInteraction.description: Activate Cancel checkout while editing or after failure. Clear the current attempt and return focus to tool selection.

alternateInputs.description: Reach Cancel checkout through ordinary focus navigation and activate the same command.

conditions: The workspace is editing or failed and contains an uncommitted attempt.

cancellation.description: Cancel is an immediate abandonment of the current uncommitted selections.

patternBasis.rationale: An explicit cancel command that abandons uncommitted form values is familiar and directly serves the supplied recovery requirement.

actions.name: Begin another checkout
actions.purpose: Deliberately leave the completed result and start a new checkout.
actions.outcome: An empty checkout attempt replaces the completed pairing in the workspace without reversing the recorded checkout.

canonicalInteraction.description: After reviewing success, activate Begin another checkout. Clear the displayed pair for a new attempt and focus tool selection.

alternateInputs.description: Reach Begin another checkout through ordinary focus navigation and activate the same command.

conditions: The workspace is saved and displays a completed checkout.

cancellation.description: Beginning another checkout immediately opens an empty attempt; it does not undo the previous result.

patternBasis.rationale: An explicit continuation command after a persistent success result is a familiar interaction and implements the brief's deliberate restart requirement.
An empty form with labeled single selections and an unavailable submit command is familiar.

regions.name: Tool and borrowing member
regions.purpose: Choose the two members of the checkout pair.

regions.name: Checkout actions
regions.purpose: Make the required selections apparent before recording is possible.

content.text: Select one available tool and one borrowing member to record a checkout.
content.purpose: Explain why Record checkout is unavailable.

affordances.label: Record checkout — unavailable until both selections are complete

focus.entry: Focus tool selection on initial entry, cancellation, or beginning another checkout. Use ordinary keyboard traversal and visible focus; an unavailable command cannot activate.

interactionFrames.name: Review checkout pair
interactionFrames.purpose: Complete or correct selections and review the pair before recording.

patternBasis.rationale: Reviewing selected form values in place before explicit submission is familiar and needs no separate confirmation surface.

regions.name: Tool and borrowing member
regions.purpose: Show the current pair in the same controls used to correct it.

content.text: The selection controls visibly identify the current tool and borrowing member; any missing selection remains apparent. This pair has not yet been recorded.
content.purpose: Support review of the actual current pair without a separate review action.

regions.name: Checkout actions
regions.purpose: Record the reviewed pair or abandon the uncommitted attempt.

affordances.label: Record checkout — available when both selections are complete

focus.entry: Keep focus on the selection being changed. Follow tool, member, Record checkout, and Cancel checkout in ordinary keyboard order with visible focus. Skip activation of Record checkout while a selection is missing.

interactionFrames.name: Recording checkout
interactionFrames.purpose: Show the submitted pair and progress while preventing duplicate submission.

patternBasis.rationale: A pending form submission that retains context and suppresses additional activation is familiar.

regions.name: Submitted pair
regions.purpose: Retain the exact pair whose recording is pending.

content.text: The exact submitted tool and borrowing member remain visibly identified and cannot be changed while recording is pending.

regions.name: Checkout actions
regions.purpose: Keep the recording command visibly in its in-progress state.

regions.name: Checkout progress
regions.purpose: Communicate progress until the asynchronous result is known.

content.text: Recording checkout. On success, the workspace enters saved; on failure, it enters failed with both selections retained.
content.purpose: Make pending work apparent and define both asynchronous result transitions.

focus.entry: Retain a stable focus location when recording starts and announce progress. The recording command cannot reactivate; selection changes and cancellation are unavailable. Do not move focus back to the start of the workspace.

interactionFrames.name: Checkout recorded
interactionFrames.purpose: Retain the exact completed pairing and allow deliberate continuation.

patternBasis.rationale: A persistent completion result with an explicit action to begin again is familiar and follows the supplied success requirement.

regions.name: Completed pair
regions.purpose: Keep the exact completed checkout available for staff to inspect.

content.text: Show the exact tool and borrowing member from the successful checkout as read-only information. Retain both until staff activate Begin another checkout.
content.purpose: Make the completed pairing explicit without silently clearing or substituting selections.

regions.name: Continue
regions.purpose: Let staff deliberately leave the retained result and start another attempt.

regions.name: Checkout result
regions.purpose: Confirm completion independently of the retained pair.

content.purpose: Distinguish a completed checkout from a selected or pending pair.

focus.entry: Announce success and keep the completed pair available in reading order. If the prior recording control held focus and is removed, place focus on the completion status; the next actionable stop is Begin another checkout. Require a fresh deliberate activation to begin again.

interactionFrames.name: Checkout recording failed
interactionFrames.purpose: Preserve the attempted pair and provide retry, correction, and cancellation.

patternBasis.rationale: Retaining failed form values with retry, direct correction, and cancel is familiar and explicitly required by the brief.

regions.name: Retained pair
regions.purpose: Keep both selections available for review and correction.

content.text: The tool and borrowing member from the failed attempt remain selected. Changing either returns to editing with the corrected pair still uncommitted.
content.purpose: Preserve staff work and make correction direct.

regions.name: Recover checkout
regions.purpose: Retry the retained pair or cancel the uncommitted attempt.

regions.name: Recording failure
regions.purpose: Explain the failure and available recovery without erasing selections.

content.text: Checkout could not be recorded. Retry, change either selection, or cancel this attempt.
content.purpose: Make failure explicit and identify the next available actions.

focus.entry: Announce failure without discarding focus or selections. Keep Retry checkout reachable at the existing recording command, with ordinary keyboard access to either selection and Cancel checkout. Show visible focus for every available control.

pruningReview.summary: One task uses one workspace. Review occurs through the visible pair, retry reuses the recording command, and correction reuses the selection controls. Cancel and Begin another checkout appear only in their meaningful states. Keyboard access remains an alternate input to the same actions.

decisions.candidate: Direct tool and borrowing member selection
decisions.rationale: Both selections are required, and the same controls support correction and review.
decisions.result: Retain one action for each selection, with keyboard input attached to that action.

decisions.rationale: Retry invokes the same recording outcome for the retained pair.
decisions.result: Use one recording command whose presentation changes to Retry checkout after failure and whose saving state suppresses activation.

decisions.rationale: Cancellation has a useful meaning only while an uncommitted attempt can be abandoned.
decisions.result: Expose Cancel checkout in editing and failed, and omit it during saving and after success.

decisions.rationale: Starting again must be deliberate after success so the completed pairing remains visible.
decisions.result: Expose Begin another checkout only in saved.

decisions.candidate: A separate review command or confirmation surface
decisions.rationale: The pair is already visible together in the single workspace before the explicit recording action.
decisions.result: Keep review within the canonical selection-and-recording flow without adding another control or surface.

flowNodes.response: The selected tool remains visibly identified in the current pair.
The member remains visibly identified alongside the selected tool so staff can review the pair.

flowNodes.action: Review the displayed pair and activate Record checkout.
flowNodes.response: The workspace enters saving, preserves the submitted pair, and prevents another submission. Success enters saved and retains the exact completed pairing.

flowNodes.prompt: Staff identify the member before the tool.
flowNodes.response: Either selection can be made first; recording still requires both. Complete the other selection and review the pair.

flowNodes.prompt: One or both selections are missing.
flowNodes.response: Record checkout remains unavailable and the missing selection is apparent. Complete the selections using the same fields.

flowNodes.prompt: Staff notice an incorrect selection before recording.
flowNodes.response: They can replace either selection directly without leaving the workspace. Review the corrected pair before recording.

flowNodes.prompt: Recording has started and its result is pending.
flowNodes.response: The submitted pair remains visible, selection changes are unavailable, and further submission is suppressed. Wait for the saved or failed result; cancellation of an in-progress recording is not offered.
The workspace enters failed, retains both selections, and explains that recording failed. Retry through the existing recording command, correct either selection, or cancel the uncommitted attempt.

flowNodes.prompt: Staff abandon an uncommitted editing or failed attempt.
flowNodes.response: Cancel checkout clears the selections and returns the workspace to empty. Staff may select a new pair; this action does not claim to undo a completed checkout.

flowNodes.prompt: The checkout has succeeded and staff want to continue.
flowNodes.response: The completed pair remains visible until staff activate Begin another checkout. That deliberate action returns the workspace to empty and focuses tool selection.
